source: сделай игру про торнадо и город где можно заходить в дома и перехватчики

image_prompt.text: A tornado as a moving damaging volume that tracks across the city
Raised ground and elevated structures to climb to when the streets become unsafe
City buildings held together by structural welds so the tornado can realistically tear them down
Houses and shops along the streets that players actually go inside
interceptors positioned around the city that players can get into
city streets and blocks laid out in an urban grid

notes: The Russian word perekhvatchiki (interceptors) is ambiguous - it reads as vehicles or craft that intercept the tornado, but it could also mean static counter-tornado emplacements. Built as enterable vehicles.
Disaster Survival deliberately carries no escape gate; the win is outlasting the event, not reaching an exit.

open_questions.ask: Do players survive the tornado, or chase and intercept it? The interceptors suggest the second, which is a different map.
Are the interceptors vehicles you drive, or fixed installations you man?
